## 描述

Spin-on oil filter, part number 15208-AD200, for passenger cars. The catalogue gives only this number and the car segment — no thread, no canister size, no micron level, no relief-valve figure. In practice the mounting thread and the gasket seat decide whether the part bolts up and seals; the media and the bypass valve then decide whether it protects. Buyers should pull the spec sheet and confirm thread pitch, gasket diameter and the relief-valve setting before buying in volume.
